A complete exact-integer certificate exhausts all 40 residual small-cycle attachment patterns and 3,064 cuts, with independently computed derivatives. The seven-vertex Lipschitz counterexample is verified directly by Laplacian arithmetic. Finite code is not used to prove unbounded-family statements.
